observations: Photo 0 shows the front of a black NAS device with 'WD My Cloud EX4100' branding visible on the top left. Four drive bays are present, labeled 1 to 4, with a power button and USB port below. The surface is dusty and scratched.

Photo 1 shows the same device with all four drive trays pulled out. Each tray has a barcode label, but the text is not legible. The drive trays are dusty and show signs of wear. The green LED indicators on the trays are visible but not lit.

Photo 2 shows the side and partial front of the device. The side panel is heavily scratched and dusty. The 'WD My Cloud EX4100' branding is visible on the front edge. Ventilation holes are present on the side panel.

response.reason: The model of the NAS is confirmed as WD My Cloud EX4100, but the claims about the drives (WD Red WD40EFRX 4TB) and the functionality of the unit are unverified.
